today_in_history_posts.title: BIP for Serverless Payjoin
today_in_history_posts.summary: - The Serverless Payjoin proposal introduces Payjoin version 2 with enhanced privacy and throughput.  - It replaces secure public endpoints with untrusted third-party relays using WebTransport and ChaCha20Poly1305 AEAD.  - The draft includes implementation details, backward compatibility with version 1, and new BIP 21 URI parameters.

today_in_history_posts.title: Resumable channels using OP_CHECKSIGFROMSTACK
today_in_history_posts.summary: - The proposal introduces resumable lightning channels via seed, solving backup issues.  - It features a new channel transaction with fraud-proof paths using two new opcodes.  - Asymmetric roles are set, with Alice and Bob differently managing and verifying states.

today_in_history_posts.title: Zawy’s Alternating Timestamp Attack
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Zawy's attack manipulates Bitcoin Testnet 4 by altering block timestamps.
- The attack strategy includes a variant that intensifies difficulty reduction.
- Proposed mitigation includes a softfork to enforce consistent timestamp increases.
